users.title: User Profile
users.description: User profile document storing separate individual fields per user registration

fullName.description: Full legal name of the partner

phoneNumber.description: 10-digit Indian phone number with +91 country code

registrationType.description: Selected registration type: Driver, Truck Owner, Driver & Truck Owner, Rent & Drive

truckType.description: Type of truck or commercial vehicle

vehicleLocation.description: Base parking / garage location of vehicle

aadhaarCardImage.description: Base64 or Data URL of the uploaded Aadhaar Card document image in JPG format

licenceCardImage.description: Base64 or Data URL of the uploaded Driving Licence document image in JPG format

vehicleRcImage.description: Base64 or Data URL of the uploaded Vehicle RC document image in JPG format

drivingLicencePhotoUrl.description: Firebase Cloud Storage download URL for Driving Licence photo (stored in users/{uid}/documents/drivingLicence/)

profilePhotoUrl.description: Firebase Cloud Storage download URL for user profile photo (stored in users/{uid}/profile/)

truckRCPhotoUrl.description: Firebase Cloud Storage download URL for Truck RC document photo (stored in users/{uid}/truckDocuments/)

vehiclePhotoUrl.description: Firebase Cloud Storage download URL for vehicle photo (stored in users/{uid}/vehiclePhotos/)

aadhaarCardPhotoUrl.description: Firebase Cloud Storage download URL for Aadhaar Card photo (stored in users/{uid}/documents/aadhaar/)

bankAccountHolderName.description: Full legal name on bank account

bankAccountNumberMasked.description: Masked account number displaying only last 4 digits

bankAccountUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp when bank details were added or modified
